meta.title: PR #270: chore: remove codex skills symlink
meta.summary: Deletes the legacy .codex/skills symlink so local skills are addressed through the repository's .agents/skills directory.

graphs.label: System overview
graphs.summary: Stable local skill layout used by AICodingFlow.

nodes.title: Local skill catalog
nodes.summary: AICodingFlow keeps repository-local Codex skills under .agents/skills. Each skill is a self-contained directory with a required SKILL.md and optional scripts or references.
details: This directory is the stable source of local workflow knowledge for branch creation, PR creation, review helpers, issue handling, and related automation.

nodes.title: Skill invocation path
nodes.summary: Codex loads skill metadata and instructions from explicit skill paths or discovered local skill directories. Repository guidance tells agents where those paths live.
details: The important architectural boundary is that discoverability should point at the canonical skill directory rather than a compatibility alias.

tour.title: Start with the catalog
tour.body: The stable skill source is .agents/skills, where each local workflow skill lives in its own directory.

tour.title: Then understand discovery
tour.body: Skill discovery and explicit invocation should resolve to the canonical directory rather than relying on compatibility aliases.

graphs.label: Data flow graph
graphs.summary: How the local skill path resolves after the symlink is removed.

nodes.title: Agent asks for a skill
nodes.summary: A user or workflow invokes a local skill such as git-branch or review-pr-local.
details: The request names a skill; the path resolution should use the repository's documented local skill directory.

nodes.title: .agents/skills
nodes.summary: The canonical local skills directory receives skill lookups.
details: This directory contains the actual SKILL.md files and helper scripts used by local agents.

nodes.title: Removed .codex/skills alias
nodes.summary: The compatibility symlink is deleted and no longer participates in resolution.
details: The PR removes a single symlink whose content pointed to ../.agents/skills.

tour.title: Start at skill usage
tour.body: A workflow or user invokes a skill; the walkthrough follows how that path should now resolve.

tour.title: Use the canonical source
tour.body: .agents/skills is the real data source for local skills.

tour.title: The alias leaves the flow
tour.body: The deleted symlink is the only changed path in the PR.

details: Reviewer attention should go to any docs or workflow metadata that still mention the removed alias.

comments.author: github-actions
comments.body: Review noted that current directory layout documentation still defined .codex/skills -> ../.agents/skills as the Codex default shared skills entry.

nodes.title: .codex/skills

nodes.summary: The actual skill directories remain the dependency target.
details: The PR does not alter individual skill implementations; it only removes the alias pointing to them.
